|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #1a sheet (PDF made 5 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per deploy phase, if you just deployed a unique (•) character, you may deploy a "matching weapon" on that character from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per deploy phase, if you just deployed a unique (•) character, you may deploy a "matching weapon" on that character from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' the words are the same as the previous version; the slip's look differs (Decipher's sheet prints Dark Side text boxes black on white and prints collector numbers V1•1–V1•12; the 5 March sheet prints Dark Side boxes white on black and no numbers). Listed as its own version because it is a separate publication (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Sai'torr Kal Fas (V) (Virtual Set 1) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 1: Legacy, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, if you just deployed a unique (•) character, may deploy a matching weapon on that character from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Once per” → “During your”; removed “you”; “"matching weapon"” → “matching weapon”.
